products.name: LYMPHIR (denileukin diftitox-cdxl)
products.description: A recombinant DNA-derived fusion protein oncology therapeutic, manufactured at cGMP third-party facilities, for intravenous treatment of persistent or recurrent cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) and under investigation for use in combination immuno-oncology regimens. Delivered as a biologic drug product to hospitals and cancer centers via specialty distributors and named patient programs.

products.name: Agricultural Origination and Merchandising Services
products.description: ADM sources, transports, stores, and merchandises agricultural raw materials such as grains and oilseeds globally, leveraging an integrated logistics and supply chain network to connect farmers with global markets. This involves physical infrastructure and in-person operations.

products.name: Oilseed Processing and Products
products.description: ADM crushes and processes oilseeds (soybeans, canola, sunflower, etc.) to produce vegetable oils, protein meals, and related products for food, feed, energy, and industrial customers. This requires large-scale physical manufacturing and refining facilities.

products.name: Corn and Wheat Processing and Ingredients
products.description: ADM processes corn and wheat via wet and dry milling to produce sweeteners, starches, syrups, glucose, wheat flour, dextrose, and related ingredients for food, beverage, and industrial applications. This is a capital-intensive, manufacturing-driven business.

products.name: Biofuels and Renewable Fuels
products.description: ADM converts agricultural feedstocks into biofuels such as ethanol and biodiesel, supplying renewable fuels for transportation and industrial uses. This involves regulated, large-scale manufacturing and logistics.

products.name: Animal Nutrition Ingredients and Solutions
products.description: ADM manufactures and distributes animal feed ingredients, premixes, additives, and complete feeds for livestock, aquaculture, and pets, including protein meals, distillers’ grains, and specialty nutrition products. Production involves both physical processing and formulation expertise.

products.name: Human Nutrition Ingredients and Solutions
products.description: ADM develops, manufactures, and sells a wide range of specialty ingredients for human food and beverage applications, including plant-based proteins, natural flavors and colors, emulsifiers, soluble fibers, and specialty health ingredients like probiotics and enzymes. Production is science-driven and involves both physical and digital innovation.

products.name: Health and Well-being Products
products.description: ADM produces and markets health-focused products such as probiotics, enzymes, supplements, and specialty nutrition solutions for both human and animal markets. These are developed through advanced R&D and manufacturing processes.

products.name: Edible Beans and Specialty Ingredients
products.description: ADM procures, processes, and distributes edible beans and specialty ingredients for food and feed markets, leveraging its global sourcing and processing capabilities.

products.name: Peanut and Peanut-derived Ingredients
products.description: ADM supplies peanuts and manufactures peanut-derived ingredients for food and industrial customers, involving agricultural sourcing and processing operations.

products.name: Cotton Cellulose Pulp
products.description: ADM manufactures cotton cellulose pulp in North America for use in chemical, paper, and other industrial markets, requiring specialized manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Industrial and Bio-based Solutions
products.description: ADM develops and supplies bio-based industrial products and solutions, including glycols, citric acids, and other specialty chemicals, as well as advancing carbon capture and sequestration initiatives. Production is manufacturing and R&D intensive.

products.name: Commodity Brokerage and Risk Management Services
products.description: Through ADM Investor Services, ADM provides commodity brokerage, futures commission merchant, and clearing services to external customers in the U.S., Europe, and Asia. This is a regulated, service-based business.

products.name: Insurance and Reinsurance Services
products.description: ADM, through Agrinational Insurance Company, provides insurance and participates in third-party reinsurance arrangements, offering property, casualty, marine, and other coverage to external clients.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust owns and leases full-service upper-upscale hotels and resorts, primarily in major U.S. cities and select destination resort markets. These properties are physically owned, require significant capital investment, and are operated by third-party management companies under lease agreements.

products.name: Curator Hotel & Resort Collection Membership Platform
products.description: Through Curator, Pebblebrook offers a membership platform for independent lifestyle hotels and resorts, providing access to best-in-class agreements, services, and technology. This is a digital and service-based offering aimed at enhancing performance for member hotels while allowing them to retain their unique identities.

products.name: Shelf-Stable and Frozen Food Products
products.description: A diverse portfolio of branded, high-quality, shelf-stable and frozen food products, including canned vegetables, beans, pickles, sauces, syrups, hot cereals, pasta sauces, soup mixes, and nut snacks. These products are manufactured in company-owned facilities and through co-packing arrangements, and distributed through major food channels in the U.S., Canada, and Puerto Rico.

products.name: Oils, Shortening, and Cooking Sprays
products.description: Vegetable oils, shortening, and cooking sprays primarily under the Crisco brand, produced from plant-based oils and oil seeds, and distributed through retail and foodservice channels. Manufacturing is both in-house and via co-packers.

products.name: Spices, Seasonings, and Flavor Enhancers
products.description: A broad range of spices, dried herbs, seasoning blends, extracts, marinades, rubs, and flavor enhancers sold under brands such as Dash, Spice Islands, Weber, Ac’cent, Tone’s, Durkee, Trappey’s, and Wright’s. Products are manufactured in-house and via licensing agreements, and distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Baking Products and Mixes
products.description: Baking ingredients and mixes, including baking powder, baking soda, corn starch, dessert mixes, pancake mixes, and no-stick baking sprays, sold under brands like Clabber Girl, Rumford, Davis, Hearth Club, Royal, Baker’s Joy, and Maple Grove Farms. Products are manufactured in-house and via co-packers for retail and foodservice markets.

products.name: Hot and Cold Cereals
products.description: Hot cereals such as Cream of Wheat, Cream of Rice, and McCann’s Irish oatmeal, as well as convenience-oriented oatmeal products, produced in company facilities and by co-packers for retail distribution.

products.name: Maple Syrups and Flavored Syrups
products.description: Pure maple syrup and maple-flavored syrups, as well as sugar-free and fruit-flavored syrups, sold under brands such as Maple Grove Farms, Spring Tree, Cary’s, and Vermont Maid. Syrups are sourced from Canadian suppliers and processed for retail sale.

products.name: Fruit Spreads, Preserves, and Jams
products.description: Fruit-based spreads, preserves, jams, and sugar-free or organic variants, sold under the Polaner brand and others. Products are manufactured for retail and foodservice distribution.

products.name: Pasta and Specialty Sauces
products.description: Premium pasta sauces, specialty sauces, and pizza sauces, including slow kettle-cooked varieties, sold under brands such as Victoria and Mama Mary’s. Products are manufactured using traditional methods and distributed to retail customers.

products.name: Pickles, Peppers, Relishes, and Olives
products.description: Shelf-stable pickles, peppers, relishes, olives, and related specialty items, primarily under the B&G brand, produced in company facilities and distributed mainly in the New York metropolitan area and beyond.

products.name: Beans and Baked Beans
products.description: Canned beans, including kidney, chili, and other varieties, as well as baked beans and brown bread, sold under brands such as Joan of Arc and B&M. Products are manufactured for retail and foodservice markets.

products.name: Nut Snacks and Clusters
products.description: Nut cluster snacks made from roasted nuts and other ingredients, sold under the TrueNorth brand. Products are manufactured via co-packers and distributed through retail channels.

products.name: Household Products (Static Guard)
products.description: Anti-static spray products for household use, sold under the Static Guard brand. Manufactured via co-packers and distributed through food and non-food retail channels.

products.name: Sugar Substitutes and Sweeteners
products.description: Calorie-free sugar substitutes and sweeteners, primarily under the Sugar Twin brand, manufactured for retail sale, especially in Canada.

products.name: Luxury Travel Subscriptions
products.description: Subscription-based access to a curated portfolio of private luxury vacation homes, luxury hotels, and resort accommodations worldwide, delivered through digital platforms and supported by personalized service, trip planning, and on-site concierge. Requires asset-light leasing, property management, and technology infrastructure.

products.name: Curated Luxury Travel Experiences
products.description: One-of-a-kind, member-only travel experiences such as luxury safaris, cruises, and custom-designed itineraries, delivered through expert planning and partnerships with travel providers. Requires in-person human labor and coordination with third-party suppliers.

products.name: Property Management and Leasing Services for Luxury Homeowners
products.description: Leasing and property management services for luxury vacation homeowners, including fixed monthly lease payments, expert property management, and flexible usage benefits, in exchange for including their homes in Inspirato’s portfolio. Requires regulated infrastructure, property management expertise, and financial capital.

products.name: Sequencing Platforms
products.description: Physical instruments based on proprietary sequencing-by-synthesis (SBS) chemistry, enabling high-throughput DNA and RNA sequencing for research and clinical applications. Manufactured and distributed globally, these systems are used in laboratories for whole-genome, targeted, and exome sequencing.

products.name: Sequencing Consumables
products.description: Reagents, flow cells, and library preparation kits required for operating sequencing platforms, supporting a range of applications including whole-genome, targeted, and multiomics sequencing. These are manufactured and shipped to customers for use with Illumina instruments.

products.name: Array Platforms and Consumables
products.description: Physical microarray instruments and associated consumables (arrays, reagents) for high-throughput genotyping, CNV, and methylation analysis. Manufactured using proprietary BeadArray technology, these products are used in research, agrigenomics, and clinical studies.

products.name: Genomic Data Analysis Software and Informatics Platforms
products.description: Digital software solutions, including BaseSpace Informatics Suite, DRAGEN Bio-IT Platform, and Connected Analytics, providing cloud-based and on-premises tools for managing, analyzing, and interpreting sequencing and multiomics data. Delivered as digital products to support research and clinical workflows.

products.name: Genomic Interpretation and Knowledge Aggregation Software
products.description: AI-driven and curated knowledge platforms (e.g., Emedgene, Connected Insights) for variant curation, prioritization, and interpretation in clinical and translational research. Delivered as digital tools for research use only, supporting consistent and reproducible genomic data interpretation.

products.name: Multiomics Analysis Solutions
products.description: Integrated workflows and consumables enabling simultaneous analysis of multiple biological modalities (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics), including single-cell and spatial solutions. Delivered through kits and software for advanced biological discovery and biomarker research.

products.name: Genomic and Genetic Analysis Services
products.description: Laboratory-based services including whole-genome sequencing, genotyping, noninvasive prenatal testing (NIPT), and product support, performed in CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited labs. Customers outsource sequencing and array projects to Illumina for data generation and analysis.

products.name: Force and Touch Sensors (FSR® Technology)
products.description: Thin, lightweight force-sensing resistor (FSR®) sensors and modules manufactured using proprietary printed electronics processes, integrated with firmware and software for HMI applications in consumer electronics, automotive, medical, and industrial markets.

products.name: Piezoelectric Sensors and Actuators
products.description: Ultra-thin piezoelectric polymer film sensors and actuators for dynamic strain, vibration, impact, and motion sensing, as well as haptic feedback, manufactured with printed electrodes and integrated with advanced firmware and AI for custom applications.

products.name: Printed Electronics and Membrane Keypads
products.description: Custom-designed membrane keypads, graphic overlays, printed electronic circuits, and industrial labeling solutions produced via specialized printed electronics manufacturing for use in industrial automation, medical diagnostics, and defense.

products.name: Smart Textiles and Wearable Sensor Systems
products.description: E-textile and wearable technology products integrating sensors and electronics directly into textiles and fabrics, including heated garments, medical wearable platforms, and automotive-integrated textile sensing systems, enabled by patented conductive transfer processes.

products.name: Electrochemical Gas and Environmental Sensors
products.description: Miniature, low-power electrochemical sensors and integrated systems for detecting a wide range of gases, used in safety, environmental monitoring, industrial compliance, and smart city applications, manufactured in-house with proprietary fabrication and calibration processes.

products.name: Gas and Air Quality Monitoring Instruments
products.description: Complete instruments and modules, including ozone monitors, carbon monoxide monitors, gas alarms, and air quality modules, based on proprietary sensor technology for industrial, medical, and smart city deployments.

products.name: Custom Sensor and System Design Services
products.description: End-to-end engineering services for custom sensor and module design, system integration, firmware development, and application-specific solutions, delivered through close collaboration with OEM customers across multiple industries.

products.name: Temporary Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of temporary and contract employees for short-term assignments, primarily in construction, light industrial, manufacturing, warehousing, hospitality, recycling/waste management, and disaster recovery. Services are delivered through a nationwide network of franchised offices using direct-dispatch and commercial staffing models, requiring in-person labor management and compliance with employment regulations.

products.name: Permanent Placement and Executive Recruitment Services
products.description: Professional recruitment and permanent placement services for executive, managerial, administrative, and professional roles, delivered through specialized franchised offices and brands. This service involves digital and in-person recruitment processes and is offered both domestically and internationally.

products.name: Healthcare Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of skilled temporary and contract personnel for healthcare and dental industries, delivered through specialized franchise brands. This involves regulated placement of healthcare professionals requiring compliance with industry-specific standards.

products.name: Driver Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of commercial and non-CDL drivers for various industries and applications, delivered through specialized franchise offices. This service requires compliance with transportation regulations and involves in-person vetting and dispatch.

products.name: Skilled Trades Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of skilled trades personnel for construction sites and related industries, delivered through specialized franchise offices. This involves recruiting and dispatching workers with specific trade skills for project-based assignments.

products.name: Crude Oil
products.description: Crude oil is extracted from company-operated wells in the DJ Basin (Colorado) and Permian Basin (Texas and New Mexico) using horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing. The product is physically produced, gathered, and sold to external purchasers through established infrastructure and pipelines.

products.name: Natural Gas
products.description: Natural gas is produced alongside crude oil from horizontal wells in the DJ and Permian Basins, processed, and sold to external customers. Production involves regulated infrastructure, gathering, and transportation to market via pipelines.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs)
products.description: Natural gas liquids (NGLs) are separated from produced natural gas at processing facilities and sold as distinct products. NGLs require specialized processing and regulated transportation to market.

products.name: Power Conversion and Distribution Equipment
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured power supplies, power converters, filters, power transformers, magnetic components, power distribution equipment, and UPS systems for military and rugged industrial applications. These products are physically manufactured and tested in-house to meet stringent reliability and environmental standards.

products.name: Antennas for Military and Industrial Applications
products.description: Design and manufacture of antennas for use in military and industrial environments, produced in-house to customer specifications and tested for reliability in severe conditions.

products.name: Engineering Design and Development Services
products.description: Provision of engineering services including custom product design, design studies, and development to customer specifications, often as part of contracts for new or improved power electronics products. Delivered by in-house engineering teams and may include upfront design costs.

products.name: Environmental Testing Services
products.description: Contract-based environmental testing services for external customers, utilizing in-house facilities to qualify products for mechanical, electrical, and environmental standards required in military and industrial applications.

products.name: Metal Fabrication and Painting Services
products.description: Provision of metal fabrication and painting services to external customers, using in-house machine shop and finishing facilities on a contract basis.

products.name: VOXZOGO (vosoritide)
products.description: A once-daily injectable analog of C-type Natriuretic Peptide (CNP) for the treatment of achondroplasia and other growth disorders. Manufactured using recombinant technology and delivered via injection, it is approved in multiple global markets.

products.name: Enzyme Replacement Therapies for Lysosomal Storage Disorders
products.description: A portfolio of recombinant enzyme therapies, including VIMIZIM, NAGLAZYME, and ALDURAZYME, for the treatment of various mucopolysaccharidoses (MPS I, MPS IVA, MPS VI). These are biologic drugs produced via recombinant DNA technology and administered by injection or infusion.

products.name: Phenylketonuria (PKU) Therapies
products.description: Therapies for PKU, including PALYNZIQ (a PEGylated recombinant enzyme delivered by subcutaneous injection) and KUVAN (a synthetic oral co-factor). These products are manufactured using recombinant and synthetic chemistry and are distributed globally.

products.name: BRINEURA (cerliponase alfa)
products.description: A recombinant human tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1) enzyme therapy for the treatment of CLN2 disease (a form of Batten disease). Manufactured using recombinant technology and administered via intracerebroventricular infusion with a delivery device.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Hemophilia A (ROCTAVIAN)
products.description: An adeno-associated virus (AAV5) vector gene therapy designed to restore factor VIII plasma concentrations in patients with severe hemophilia A. Manufactured using viral vector technology and administered as a one-time infusion. Note: Product is being withdrawn from the market.

products.name: Fabry Disease and Pompe Disease Therapies (via Amicus acquisition)
products.description: Therapies for Fabry disease and late-onset Pompe disease, to be added through the pending acquisition of Amicus Therapeutics. These are biologic therapies for rare genetic disorders, manufactured using advanced biotechnological methods.

products.name: ENPP1 Deficiency Therapy (BMN 401)
products.description: A late-stage enzyme replacement therapy for the treatment of ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase 1 (ENPP1) deficiency, acquired via Inozyme Pharma. Manufactured as a recombinant or genetically engineered fusion protein.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a full range of commercial loans, including commercial mortgages, asset-based financing, working capital lines of credit, and SBA-guaranteed loans, primarily to small and medium-sized businesses. Lending is delivered through in-person relationship management and is funded by core deposits.

products.name: Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial and residential real estate, including development, construction, and home loans. Loans are originated and serviced through branch networks and require in-person underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides traditional consumer loans such as automobile loans, home equity loans, and other personal loans to individuals, delivered through branch locations and requiring in-person application and underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a comprehensive suite of deposit products including checking, NOW, savings, money market, health savings, education, retirement accounts, and certificates of deposit, as well as overdraft protection and auto draft services. Delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides cash management solutions for business and institutional clients, including funds transfer, collections, and related services, delivered via digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Trust and Investment Management Services
products.description: Offers investment management and administration of trusts for individuals, corporations, and employee benefit plans, as well as serving as bond trustee and paying agent for municipalities. Services require specialized human expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides business and personal insurance, employee benefits, surety bonds, and claims and risk management through BancFirst Insurance Services, Inc., operating as an independent insurance agency. Delivered via licensed agents and regulated by insurance authorities.

products.name: Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Delivers item processing, research, and other correspondent banking services to financial institutions and governmental units, leveraging centralized processing infrastructure and specialized expertise.

products.name: Systemic DNase Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A biologic drug candidate based on recombinant human DNase I, designed to degrade neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) to improve outcomes of existing cancer treatments, including immunotherapies and chemotherapies, for difficult-to-treat solid tumors such as pancreatic cancer and colorectal carcinoma. Delivered via intravenous infusion, it is produced using contract manufacturing and is in clinical and preclinical development.

products.name: DNase-Armored CAR T Cell Therapy
products.description: A preclinical cell therapy platform involving engineered Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T cells that are modified to secrete DNase, aiming to enhance CAR T cell infiltration and efficacy in solid tumors by degrading NETs and overcoming tumor microenvironment barriers. Developed through academic collaborations and preclinical research.

products.name: PolyXen Drug Delivery Platform (Out-Licensed)
products.description: A proprietary polysialic acid (PSA)-based drug delivery technology designed to prolong the half-life and improve the stability of protein, peptide, and small molecule therapeutics. The platform is licensed to pharmaceutical partners for use in developing drugs for blood coagulation disorders and other indications, generating royalty revenue.

products.name: ErepoXen (PSA-EPO) for Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (Out-Licensed)
products.description: A polysialylated erythropoietin (PSA-EPO) therapeutic for the treatment of anemia in chronic kidney disease patients, utilizing the PolyXen platform to extend dosing intervals. The product is out-licensed to partners for development and commercialization in select markets, with the company receiving royalties.

products.name: Legal and Business Newspapers and Online Publications
products.description: The company publishes newspapers and corresponding online editions focused on legal, business, and real estate news, primarily in California and Arizona. These are produced through traditional print and digital publishing, distributed by mail, hand delivery, and online access, and generate revenue from subscriptions and advertising.

products.name: Public Notice and Legal Advertising Services
products.description: The company provides public notice advertising services required or permitted by law, specializing in legal notices, foreclosure listings, and probate sale notices, delivered through its newspapers and online platforms. This service is sold to law firms, businesses, and government entities.

products.name: Case Management Software and Related Services for Justice Agencies
products.description: Through Journal Technologies, the company develops, licenses, and supports browser-based case management software systems for courts, prosecutors, public defenders, probation departments, and other justice agencies. Delivery includes software licensing, maintenance, hosting, consulting, and implementation services, primarily to government agencies.

products.name: Electronic Filing and Payment Services
products.description: The company offers browser-based platforms for electronic filing of court documents (eFile-it™) and online payment of traffic citations (ePay-it™), enabling attorneys and the public to interact with courts digitally. These services are delivered via secure web interfaces and generate transaction-based fees.

products.name: Specialized Legal Information Services and Publications
products.description: The company produces specialized legal information products, including multi-volume court rules sets, judicial profiles, and continuing legal education tests, delivered in print and online formats. These are sold as subscriptions or one-time purchases to legal professionals.

products.name: Therapeutics for Rare Metabolic Disorders
products.description: Novel therapeutics developed using synthetic biology and engineered live biotherapeutics, focused on treating rare metabolic disorders such as phenylketonuria (PKU) and homocystinuria (HCU). These products require advanced research, clinical trials, and regulated manufacturing processes.

products.name: Golf Recreation Services
products.description: Operation of two public golf country clubs offering daily-fee access to 36 holes of golf, including green fees, golf cart rental, and access to practice facilities such as aquatic driving ranges and putting greens. Services are delivered in-person at physical golf courses with maintained grounds and facilities.

products.name: Retail Golf Products and Equipment Rental
products.description: Sale of golf apparel, accessories, and equipment through on-site pro shops, as well as rental of golf clubs and other equipment to guests. Products are sold and rented in-person at club facilities, with custom-order options for certain equipment.

products.name: Club Memberships
products.description: Annual membership programs providing unlimited golf access and select discounts at both clubs. Memberships are sold directly to individuals and provide recurring revenue, but are not widely advertised and represent a minority of total revenue.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Provision of freshly prepared meals, snacks, and alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages at clubhouses and via beverage carts. Services are delivered on-site by culinary staff and bartenders, with licensed alcohol sales and regular menu updates.

products.name: Event and Banquet Services
products.description: Rental of clubhouse event spaces and provision of event hosting services for private events such as weddings, galas, business meetings, and golf tournaments. Services include event planning, catering, and facility rental, leveraging scenic club settings and flexible packages.

products.name: Casino Operations
products.description: Operation of a Casino offering unbanked card games, including poker and table games, at the Canterbury Park Racetrack and Casino facility. This is a physical, regulated gaming operation requiring in-person attendance and significant human labor.

products.name: Pari-Mutuel Horse Racing and Wagering
products.description: Provision of live thoroughbred and quarter horse racing events and year-round simulcast wagering on horse races, both on-site and via advanced deposit wagering (ADW) for Minnesota residents. This involves regulated, in-person and digital wagering infrastructure and live event management.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of food and beverage outlets, including concession stands, restaurants, bars, and buffets, as well as catering services at the Racetrack and Casino. This is a physical, in-person service requiring food preparation, service staff, and event support.

products.name: Event and Venue Rental Services
products.description: Rental of event spaces for a variety of purposes, including trade shows, tournaments, concerts, and other activities, utilizing both indoor and outdoor facilities at Canterbury Park. This is a physical service involving facility management and event support.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Leasing
products.description: Development, sale, and leasing of residential, office, retail, hospitality, and entertainment properties through joint ventures and direct land sales, primarily within the Canterbury Commons mixed-use development. This involves land development, construction, and property management.

products.name: Professional Tools
products.description: Manufactured and marketed hand tools, power tools (cordless, pneumatic, hydraulic, corded), and tool storage products for professional users, produced in Snap-on facilities and supplemented by externally sourced items. Delivered via mobile vans, direct sales, distributors, and digital commerce.

products.name: Diagnostics, Information and Management Systems
products.description: Handheld and computer-based diagnostic products, repair information software, diagnostic software, electronic parts catalogs, business/shop management systems, and OEM dealership solutions, delivered digitally or as integrated systems to repair shops and dealerships.

products.name: Vehicle and Industrial Equipment
products.description: Manufactured and distributed equipment for vehicle and industrial service, including wheel alignment, wheel balancers, tire changers, vehicle lifts, collision repair, air conditioning service, brake service, fluid exchange, and safety testing equipment, delivered through direct sales, distributors, and franchisees.

products.name: Asset and Tool Control Solutions
products.description: Engineered solutions for facility-level tool control and asset management, including hardware and software systems, custom kits, and custom-built tools, primarily for industrial and critical industry customers. Delivered as integrated systems or products.

products.name: OEM Facilitation and Specialty Tools
products.description: Consulting, procurement, distribution, and administrative support services for OEM dealership equipment programs, including development and distribution of special and essential tools for OEMs and their dealerships.

products.name: Training and After-Sales Support
products.description: Training programs and after-sales support services focused on the technologies and application of Snap-on’s diagnostics and vehicle service shop equipment, delivered primarily to professional customers and repair shops.

products.name: Financial Services
products.description: Financing programs for customers and franchisees, including installment sales, lease contracts, business and vehicle loans, and working capital loans, delivered through Snap-on Credit LLC and international finance subsidiaries.

products.name: Stablecoins (USDC and EURC)
products.description: Digitally issued payment stablecoins backed by liquid reserves, enabling near-instant, low-cost value storage and transfer over blockchain networks. Issued and redeemed by Circle, integrated with global financial systems, and available to institutions and end-users.

products.name: Tokenized Money Market Fund (USYC)
products.description: Onchain representation of a traditional money market fund, providing yield-bearing digital tokens primarily for use as collateral in digital asset markets. Offered to eligible non-U.S. customers and integrated with Circle's stablecoin infrastructure.

products.name: Blockchain Network (Arc)
products.description: Open, enterprise-grade Layer-1 blockchain network designed to support programmable money, stablecoin payments, foreign exchange, and capital markets transactions. Provides fast, secure, and customizable settlement for onchain economic activity.

products.name: Developer Tools (Circle Wallets and Circle Contracts)
products.description: Suite of products for developers to build, deploy, and operate onchain applications, including programmable wallet solutions and smart contract platforms that simplify integration of digital assets and reduce operational risks.

products.name: Interoperability Services (CCTP and Gateway)
products.description: Onchain utilities enabling seamless, secure, and cost-efficient transfer of stablecoins across multiple blockchains, providing unified balances and liquidity for end-users and businesses.

products.name: Institutional Liquidity and Custody Services (Circle Mint and xReserve)
products.description: Services for institutional customers to mint, redeem, and manage stablecoins and other digital assets, including custody, liquidity management, and interoperability infrastructure for deploying and integrating stablecoins across blockchains.

products.name: Payments and Money Movement Applications (Circle Payments Network - CPN)
products.description: Enterprise-grade network and application layer enabling banks, payment service providers, and enterprises to move money using stablecoins for cross-border payments, remittances, payroll, and other money movement use cases, with near-instant, 24/7/365 settlement.

products.name: Stablecoin Foreign Exchange (StableFX)
products.description: Institutional-grade stablecoin foreign exchange engine enabling eligible institutions to access and settle stablecoin currency pairs with onchain settlement and reduced counterparty risk, supporting multiple stablecoin currencies.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: A full range of banking services provided to individual and commercial customers, including deposit accounts and lending, delivered through physical branches in Northern and Central California and supported by regulated infrastructure and in-person human labor.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Insured deposit accounts such as checking, savings, and other deposit products for individuals and businesses, managed through regulated banking infrastructure and physical branches.

products.name: Lending Products
products.description: A variety of lending products including commercial and consumer loans, provided to individuals and businesses, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans (working capital, equipment, lender finance, food and agribusiness, government/non-profit, owner-occupied real estate), non-owner occupied commercial real estate loans, and business loans. These are originated and serviced through in-person relationship managers and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulated underwriting.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) and Government-Guaranteed Lending
products.description: Offers SBA loans (7(a), 504, Express, CAPLine) and other government-guaranteed loans (USDA, Farm Service Agency) to small businesses and entrepreneurs, leveraging preferred lender status for expedited approval and servicing. Delivered through both physical and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides residential real estate loans, including mortgages for primary, secondary, and investment properties, home equity loans, and residential construction loans. Loans are originated directly to consumers, with many sold into the secondary market, and supported by dedicated mortgage bankers and digital origination channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as personal lines of credit, term loans, home improvement loans, auto loans, both secured and unsecured. These are provided directly to consumers through banking centers and digital platforms, requiring regulated underwriting and compliance.

products.name: Deposit Products (Consumer and Commercial)
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, health savings, time deposits, and IRAs. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Treasury Management and Commercial Payment Services
products.description: Delivers treasury management solutions to business clients, including online and mobile banking, commercial credit cards, wire transfers, ACH, bill payment, lock box, remote deposit capture, merchant processing, cash vault, controlled disbursements, fraud prevention, and sweep accounts. Services are provided via digital platforms and in-person support, requiring regulated systems and technology.

products.name: Digital Banking and Financial Ecosystem Services (2UniFi)
products.description: Provides digital banking services and a financial ecosystem platform (2UniFi) for small- and medium-sized businesses, offering digital payment tools, information management, real-time access to financial services, and integration with multiple banks and fintechs. Delivered via a national digital platform, requiring scalable, secure technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Digital Deposit Acquisition and Processing (Cambr)
products.description: Operates Cambr, a digital deposit acquisition and processing platform that gathers deposits via third-party embedded finance companies, providing liquidity to banks and alternative funding sources. Delivered through a digital platform, requiring technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides trust, estate, and wealth management services, including fiduciary services and investment management for individuals, trusts, endowments, charities, and retirement accounts. Delivered through specialized teams and regulated entities, requiring professional expertise and compliance with fiduciary standards.

products.name: Subsidized Wireless Services
products.description: Provides discounted or free wireless connectivity to eligible consumers through government-supported programs such as Lifeline. Delivered via direct carrier relationships and a mobile virtual network platform, distributed through retail and digital channels.

products.name: Prepaid Wireless Services
products.description: Offers contract-free, prepaid wireless plans under brands like LinkUp Mobile, distributed through a network of convenience stores and digital channels. Customers can activate and manage service in-store or online, targeting value-conscious and underserved consumers.

products.name: Wholesale Wireless Enablement (MVNE Platform)
products.description: Provides wireless enablement services to third-party providers, including SIM provisioning, billing, and network access, leveraging direct carrier relationships and a proprietary technology platform. Delivered as a B2B service to companies lacking direct carrier agreements.

products.name: Point of Sale Transaction Processing and Software
products.description: Delivers point of sale (POS) software and transaction processing solutions to retail partners, enabling processing of prepaid wireless top-ups, SIM activations, and financial transactions such as debit and gift card services. Provided as a software platform integrated with retail operations.

products.name: Prepaid Wireless Top-Ups
products.description: Enables consumers to purchase and reload prepaid wireless credits at convenience stores and retail locations through a transaction platform. Distributed via a broad retail network and supported by POS technology.

products.name: In-Store Digital Advertising and Managed Marketing Services
products.description: Provides digital advertising and marketing services to third-party brands via in-store digital displays (e.g., smart TVs) installed at retail partner locations. Delivered as a managed service leveraging store traffic and digital content delivery.

products.name: ClearLine Digital Engagement Platform
products.description: Transforms payment terminals into digital engagement and SaaS marketing tools, offering loyalty programs, targeted marketing campaigns, and customer feedback solutions for merchants. Delivered as a software and data-driven service to retail partners.

products.name: CGuard Carotid Stent Systems (CGuard EPS and CGuard Prime)
products.description: Self-expanding nitinol stents covered with proprietary MicroNet mesh, designed and manufactured for carotid artery revascularization to prevent embolic events during and after stenting procedures. Delivered via specialized catheter systems, these devices are physically manufactured, sterilized, and distributed globally for use in minimally invasive carotid artery stenting (CAS and TCAR) and acute stroke interventions.

products.name: SwitchGuard Neuroprotection System (SwitchGuard NPS)
products.description: A neuroprotection device composed of medical-grade tubing and an in-line blood filter, designed to provide flow reversal and filter embolic debris during carotid interventions, particularly in TCAR procedures. The system is physically manufactured and intended to be paired with CGuard stents for enhanced cerebral protection.

products.name: NOCISCAN Suite (including NOCICALC and NOCIGRAM)
products.description: A cloud-hosted, software-based medical device suite for post-processing MR spectroscopy (MRS) data to diagnose discogenic low back pain. The suite includes NOCICALC, a Class I 510(k)-exempt medical device, and NOCIGRAM, clinical decision support software. Data is acquired from compatible MR scanners (Siemens and Philips), uploaded to Aclarion's cloud, processed, and diagnostic reports are delivered to clinicians. Delivery is digital and requires integration with MR imaging centers and healthcare providers.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Includes checking accounts, savings accounts, and other types of deposit accounts offered to consumer and commercial customers through physical branches and digital channels. These products are managed and delivered via regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Comprehensive lending services to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, auto dealer flooring, commercial real estate loans, and construction loans. These are delivered through in-person relationship management and underwriting, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Lending services to individuals and small businesses, including residential mortgage loans, indirect auto financing, personal installment loans, and small business loans. Delivered through branch, online, and mobile channels, requiring regulated underwriting and servicing.

products.name: Credit Card Services
products.description: Issuance of consumer and commercial credit cards, including transaction processing and account management. Delivered via physical cards and digital platforms, requiring payment network integration and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Merchant Processing Services
products.description: Payment processing services for business customers, enabling acceptance of credit and debit card payments. Delivered through digital payment infrastructure and merchant support, requiring technology integration and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management for individuals, including investment management, financial planning, insurance products, trust and estate services, and private banking. Delivered through licensed advisors and digital platforms, requiring regulatory oversight and fiduciary management.

products.name: Gaming Products and Services
products.description: Hardware and software solutions for gamers and streamers, including gaming mice, keyboards, headsets, steering wheels, microphones, and streaming/monetization tools. These products are physically manufactured and enhanced with proprietary software and AI technologies.

products.name: Keyboards and Combos
products.description: Corded and cordless keyboards and keyboard-mouse combinations, including specialized models for creators and professionals. Products are physically manufactured and often enhanced with software for customization and workflow automation.

products.name: Pointing Devices
products.description: A range of wireless and wired mice and other pointing devices, including ergonomic and specialized models. These are physically manufactured and often include proprietary connectivity and control software.

products.name: Video Collaboration Solutions
products.description: Hardware and software solutions for video conferencing, including conference room cameras, video bars, touch controllers, companion cameras, and integrated video conferencing boards. These are physically manufactured and often include built-in computing and AI-driven features.

products.name: Webcams
products.description: PC-based webcams for individual use, including streaming and video conferencing cameras. These are physically manufactured and designed for both professional and personal content creation and communication.

products.name: Tablet Accessories
products.description: Accessories for tablets, primarily keyboards, protective folios, and digital pens, designed for iPads and select Android tablets. These are physically manufactured and often integrate with tablet hardware via proprietary or standard connectors.

products.name: Headsets and Earbuds
products.description: A range of headsets, in-ear headphones, and wireless earbuds for PC, video conferencing, and general audio use. These are physically manufactured and include both consumer and business-focused models.

products.name: Speakers (Mobile and PC)
products.description: Portable wireless Bluetooth speakers and PC speakers for music and audio playback. These are physically manufactured and designed for both mobile and stationary use.

products.name: Power Discrete Semiconductors (MOSFETs and IGBTs)
products.description: Manufactured analog and mixed-signal power discrete semiconductor devices, including MOSFETs and IGBTs, for use in consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial applications. Production involves in-house wafer fabrication and packaging, requiring specialized manufacturing infrastructure and process technology.

products.name: Power Integrated Circuits (Power ICs)
products.description: Design and sale of power management integrated circuits, including AC-DC/DC-DC converters, LED drivers, regulators, and PMICs, for consumer electronics, computing, and automotive applications. These are fabless products, designed in-house and manufactured at external foundries using standard BCD process technologies.

products.name: Commercial Laundry Equipment
products.description: A full line of stand-alone commercial laundry systems, including washer extractors, topload washers, frontload washers, tumblers, and dryers, manufactured using high-quality steel and advanced engineering for durability and reliability. These products are produced in vertically integrated facilities and sold globally to laundromats, on-premise laundry operators, and commercial in-home customers.

products.name: Aftermarket Service Parts
products.description: Service parts and components for the maintenance and repair of installed laundry equipment, supporting a large global installed base. Parts are distributed online and through distributors, providing recurring, high-margin revenue.

products.name: Laundry Chemicals and Consumables
products.description: Detergents, softeners, and other laundry chemicals sold to both on-premise and vended laundry operators, including direct injection solutions and chemical-inclusive pricing models. These consumables are distributed alongside equipment sales and represent a growing, high-margin recurring revenue stream.

products.name: Digital Laundry Management Platforms
products.description: Proprietary cloud-connected digital platforms (e.g., Speed Queen Insights, Huebsch Command, UniMac Core) that provide remote monitoring, machine control, payment processing, performance analytics, and fleet management for commercial laundry operators. Delivered as subscription-based software services integrated with physical equipment.

products.name: Equipment Financing Services
products.description: Financing solutions for customers purchasing commercial laundry equipment, offering flexible arrangements to enable access to essential equipment. This service is provided directly to customers and supports equipment sales growth.

products.name: Value-Added Support Services
products.description: A suite of complementary services including laundromat site selection assistance, commercial laundry room design, operator and distributor training, technical assistance, and on-call installation and repair services. These services are provided to support equipment customers and enhance customer satisfaction and retention.

products.name: Scrypt Proof-of-Work Compute (Hashrate) Services
products.description: Datacentrex owns and operates specialized Scrypt ASIC mining hardware deployed in third-party colocation facilities to generate proof-of-work hashrate, which is monetized primarily through hashrate marketplace mechanisms. The company delivers computational capacity for blockchain validation to third-party buyers, with settlement typically in Bitcoin. This service requires significant capital investment in hardware, ongoing operational management, and access to regulated power infrastructure.

products.name: Branded Audio and Video Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of Dolby-branded audio and video technologies (including Dolby Atmos, Dolby Vision, and branded audio codecs such as DD+ and AC-4) to device manufacturers, content creators, and distributors. Delivered primarily as software, patent rights, and know-how for integration into consumer electronics and content production workflows.

products.name: Patent Licensing for Standardized Audio and Video Codecs
products.description: Licensing of Dolby-owned patents essential to standardized audio and video codecs (such as AAC, HE-AAC, AVC, HEVC, and others) to manufacturers of devices that capture, store, transmit, or playback media. Delivered through patent pools and bilateral agreements, covering billions of devices worldwide.

products.name: Cinema Hardware and Software Solutions
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of audio, imaging, accessibility, and other hardware and software products for cinemas, including digital cinema servers, cinema processors, amplifiers, loudspeakers, and related software for media encryption, encoding, and playback. Delivered as physical products and software to cinema exhibitors and related industries.

products.name: Cinema Services and Support
products.description: Provision of services to support theatrical and television production, including equipment training, maintenance, mixing room alignment, equalization, and calibration of audio, color, and light. Also includes post-sale support and maintenance for cinema hardware and Dolby Cinema installations.

products.name: Dolby Cinema Premium Theater Experience
products.description: Operation and licensing of Dolby Cinema, a premium large format (PLF) cinema experience combining Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, and proprietary theater design. Revenue is generated through a share of box office receipts with exhibitor partners.

products.name: Dolby OptiView (SaaS for Real-Time Interactive Experiences)
products.description: Software-as-a-service platform enabling immersive, interactive, and social experiences for live events, especially sports, by delivering high-quality, synchronized video and real-time engagement tools. Licensed directly to enterprises via a consumption-based model.
